source.dateNote: Source metadata reported in original public edition; no independent source-date revalidation.

normalization.overview: David Ondrej interviews Supabase co-founder Ant Wilson about agents building and consuming software, database economics, customer discovery and headless services.
normalization.whyItMatters: Useful for builders evaluating agent-facing services. Watch the service and access-control passages; skip the promotional portions or seek separate data for market-size claims.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Keep the billing principal, caller identity and service authorization explicit. Test isolation, recovery and exit before treating agent adoption as a durable advantage.
normalization.falsification: Reconsider the recommendation if a controlled comparison on the stated task shows no benefit, or exposes permission failures, omitted evidence or greater cost than the ordinary workflow. See the original article for its specific proposed controls.
